title: MythraForge
description: MythraForge is a powerful Minecraft-style mod that introduces a new rare material called Mythra, used to craft advanced tools, armor, and unique blocks.
body:
**MythraForge** is an immersive **Minecraft**-style mod that introduces a rare and powerful material known as Mythra, Found deep underground in dangerous areas. Players can mine, refine, and craft this resource into advanced tools, armor, and unique blocks with magical properties. Each item features special abilities, glowing effects, and improved performance beyond diamond and netherite. With a dark fantasy theme, custom crafting systems, and energy-based mechanics, MythraForge delivers a rewarding progression experience focused on exploration, power, and creativity.!
